title: Conectores: however, although, therefore, because of

rule.title: Linkers: however, although, therefore, because of
rule.explanation:
Para conectar ideas en una entrevista, un correo o una redacción.

Contraste:
- «However» (sin embargo) va al principio de una frase nueva y con coma: «The deadline was short. However, we finished on time.»
- «Although» (aunque) une dos ideas en la misma frase: «Although the deadline was short, we finished on time.»
- «On the other hand» (por otro lado) presenta el otro punto de vista: «The job pays well. On the other hand, it's stressful.»
- «Despite» / «In spite of» + nombre o «-ing»: «Despite the rain, we went out.»

Causa y consecuencia:
- «because» + frase, «because of» + nombre: «because it was late», «because of the deadline»
- «so» (así que): «I was tired, so I went home.»
- «therefore» y «as a result» (por lo tanto; más formales): «We had a short deadline. Therefore, I worked late every night.»

Ojo: «although» y «but» no van juntos en la misma frase (nunca «Although it was late, but…»). Y «despite» nunca lleva «of» («despite the rain», no «despite of»).

rows: It was hard. However, we did it.
Although it was hard, we did it.
On the other hand, it's far.

items.sentence: The deadline was short. ___, we finished on time.
answers: However

items.sentence: ___ I was nervous, the interview went very well.
answers: Although

items.sentence: We worked late every night ___ the deadline.
answers: because of

items.sentence: The senior job pays more. On the ___ hand, it's more stressful.
answers: other

answers: Therefore
So

answers: Despite

answers: so

answers: because of

answers: because
Although

items.question: Aunque era tarde, seguimos trabajando.
options: Although it was late, we kept working.
Although it was late, but we kept working.

items.question: A pesar de la lluvia, salimos.
options: Despite the rain, we went out.
Despite of the rain, we went out.

items.question: Llegué tarde por el tráfico.
options: I was late because of the traffic.
I was late because the traffic.

items.question: Fue difícil. Sin embargo, lo conseguimos.
options: It was hard. However, we did it.
It was hard. Although, we did it.

items.question: Por lo tanto, acepté el trabajo.
options: Therefore, I accepted the job.
Because of, I accepted the job.

items.question: Estaba cansada, así que me fui a casa.
options: I was tired, so I went home.
I was tired, because I went home.

items.question: Por otro lado, está lejos.
options: On the other hand, it's far.
In the other hand, it's far.

items.question: Aunque es joven, tiene mucha experiencia.
options: Although he's young, he's very experienced.
Despite he's young, he's very experienced.

items.question: A pesar de estar cansado, terminó.
options: Despite being tired, he finished.
Despite he was tired, he finished.

items.question: No vine porque estaba enfermo.
options: I didn't come because I was ill.
I didn't come because of I was ill.

sets.instructions: Une las frases con el conector indicado.
